items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with one of the biggest agents at the time, booking agents, Joel Glazerman [phonetic], and he used to put me in a lot of joints that I didn‘t like, that didn‘t suit me.

ctx.x: From the bar, like a brothel.

Oh, he said, what the hell did he say? Well, I went on, did what I had to do, you know, and mainly was trying to hurry up and get out of there so I could go back in town where the action was. And he told the waitress . . . a ten-dollar bill up there, ―Give the nigger bitch a ten-dollar tip. She‘s not so bad after all.‖ And I declined, you know, said, ―It‘s time for me to get out of this joint.‖ So I left. I never went back. I said, ―John, I don‘t go for that, right.‖ So he said, ―Well, contract was broken.‖…
